The Last Rites
The Last Rites ensure that all who need a funeral receive one. We must all pay the ferryman’s toll. The Headsman hunts Death Mask and The Hanged Man, two Hunters who mock the grave and who refuse to pay their toll. He’s joined by Mama Maye and members of The Death Pact, who have a staked interested in the dead staying dead. Also backed by The Reverend and the pious and fanatical, united against this blasphemy against life. Those who reject fate only feed the Corruption.
The Unquiet Dead
But The Unquiet Dead will not go gently into that good night. The Hanged Man survived nine hangings, and isn’t about to lose his neck. Death Mask knows more than anyone what it takes to survive. Joined by others who’ve crossed the boundary between life and death, together they will escape the curse of death.
The Unquite Dead Reign have reigned victorious. Use the Redeem Code below to unlock the Empty Cairn - Mosin Nagant
Redeem Code Valid until November 17th
Redeem Code: BI89-8FYV-W24M-50I9
How do I participate?
The Headsman, leading The Last Rites, it out to execute The Hanged Man and Death Mask. The Unquiet Dead band together to save themselves. Join the fight and help decide the victor in this special PvP community clash. Two teams will face off:
The Last Rites, comprised of The Headsman, Mama Maye, The Reaper, The Reverend, The Penitent, Hail Mary, Worm Bite, Lilith, Caitlyn Hammond, Ambrose Hazen (all tiers).
The Unquiet Dead: The Hanged Man, Death Mask, Angel of Death, Dame of the Dead, Sofia, The Revenant, The Drowned Kid, The Drowned Rat, Captain Laffite, Jesse Buchanan (all tiers), Antonia Higuera (all tiers).
Every kill earns your team a point—and when the dust settles, the team with the highest kill count wins and unlocks rewards for the entire community.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long will the Death Rites PvP Event be active for?
Death Rites will run from October 24th through November 10th.
How do I play?
Play as one of the selected Hunters for either team to score points for it. Every kill counts as one point!
What are the rewards for Death Rites?
While a prize will be redeemable for the entire community, only the team that comes out on top will decide what it is. If The Last Rites claim victory, everyone will unlock Patron’s Prayer (Berthier 1892 Riposte). If The Unquiet Dead win, everyone will unlock Empty Cairn (Mosin Nagant).
What happens if I don't claim the reward in time?
Unfortunately, once the reward codes have expired, they can't be used anymore, so make sure to log in and use them while you still can!
How do I use the Redeem Codes?
Boot up Hunt: Showdown 1896 > Head to your Settings > Choose "More"> Select "Redeem Code"> Input the 16-digit code and click "Redeem Code".
What if I play for Hunters from different teams?
No problem at all—each kill will count towards that team’s overall kill score.
Is there a per-person cap for Death Rites?
No. Any Hunter can contribute as many kills as they’d like.
Why doesn't it show the progression of Death Rites in-game?
With the development of Death Rites, we couldn't integrate a dedicated tab in-game within the allotted time, but this is a goal we have for moving forward!
I don’t have the DLC Hunters, can I still play?
Yes—each team has free Hunters included, which you can recruit in-game any time! Selected DLC Hunters will also on sale during this PvP Event, so keep an eye out for discounts!
I finished a Mission where I scored a kill with one of the selected Hunters, but the website didn’t update. Did I do something wrong and my kills aren’t being tracked?
Not to worry! All kills are being counted, but the website will only get updated once a day around 16:00 UTC due to technical limitation.
